description: Application Deadline Enforcement: backend validation rejecting POST /api/applications when deadline has passed; frontend bursary cards showing deadline countdown, Open/Closed badge, disabling Apply button for expired bursaries; seed data updated with mix of active and expired deadlines
steps: Backend validation already exists at line 328 of main.py: `if b.deadline < date.today(): raise HTTPException(400,"The deadline for this bursary has passed")`. Verify this check is working correctly and returns a clear error message. Test by attempting to POST /api/applications for a bursary with a past deadline via API docs at http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

In frontend/src/App.jsx, locate the BursariesPage component (around line 600). The bursary cards are rendered in the program-grid. Add deadline display logic: calculate days remaining as `Math.ceil((new Date(b.deadline + 'T23:59:59') - new Date()) / (1000*60*60*24))`, show 'X days left' if > 0, 'Expired' if <= 0. Add a badge showing 'Open' (green, tone='success') or 'Closed' (red, tone='danger') based on deadline and b.active. Pattern: `<Badge tone={b.active?(new Date(b.deadline+'T23:59:59')<new Date()?'danger':'success'):'danger'}>{b.active?(new Date(b.deadline+'T23:59:59')<new Date()?'Closed':'Open'):'Closed'}</Badge>`

In the same BursariesPage program-card rendering, find the Apply button at the bottom. Disable it when deadline has passed: check `new Date(b.deadline+'T23:59:59') < new Date()`. Replace the button with a disabled one showing 'Applications Closed' message: `{new Date(b.deadline+'T23:59:59')<new Date()?<Button block disabled>Applications Closed</Button>:<Button block onClick={()=>go('apply')}>Apply for this program <ArrowRight size={16}/></Button>}`. Preserve existing isEligible constituency check logic

Update seed_test_data.py to create a mix of active and expired deadlines. Find the bursaries_data creation loop (around line 29). Change deadline assignments: for half of bursaries, use `deadline=date.today() + timedelta(days=random.randint(5,60))` (active), for the other half use `deadline=date.today() - timedelta(days=random.randint(1,30))` (expired). Also update the main.py lifespan seed data (around line 21) to have at least one expired bursary for testing: change STEM Merit Bursary deadline to `deadline=date(2024,9,20)` (past date)

Test: restart backend, reseed database (delete smartbursary.db and restart backend to recreate with new seed data, or run `python seed_test_data.py` from backend/ directory), refresh frontend. Browse bursaries as applicant: verify Open/Closed badges appear, deadline countdown shows, expired bursaries have disabled Apply button. Try to apply to an expired bursary via frontend (should fail at client-side disabled button). Manually test backend API by POSTing to /api/applications with an expired bursary_id via http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs - should return 400 error 'The deadline for this bursary has passed'
acceptance_criteria: Backend POST /api/applications returns 400 error with message 'The deadline for this bursary has passed' when attempting to apply to a bursary with deadline < today
Frontend bursary cards display deadline with countdown (e.g. '5 days left') and show a visual badge 'Open' (green) or 'Closed' (red) based on deadline and active status
Apply button is disabled and shows 'Applications Closed' message for bursaries where deadline has passed
Seed data contains a mix of active (future deadline) and expired (past deadline) bursaries for testing
verification: Start backend: cd backend && .venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1 && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev
Open browser to http://localhost:5173, sign in as applicant (create new account or use seeded account from seed_test_data.py output)
Navigate to Bursaries page, verify some show 'Open' badge and countdown, others show 'Closed' badge
Click on an expired bursary, verify Apply button is disabled with 'Applications Closed' text
Navigate to Apply page, verify only active bursaries appear in dropdown (expired ones should still be visible in Bursaries list but not applicable)
Test API directly: open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs, authorize with JWT token, try POST /api/applications with an expired bursary_id, verify 400 error response
